services.desc: Get ready for a summer of fun at Broadway Bound! Campers don’t just put on a show, they build confidence, learn to work as a team, and become responsible rockstars. No experience? No problem! These camps are designed to build self-esteem as students refine their creativity, active listening, and concentration skills all while learning about musical theatre. In this camp, preschoolers will participate in basic theatre techniques and work on creating a production out of some well loved children’s stories. services.desc: Prather Productions has produced over 300 shows since the start of the company in 1964. That’s a lot of beautiful costumes and dazzling sets crafted by our in-house skilled designers and master carpenters. Costumes* and sets that are currently not in use are available for rental to theatre companies across the country. Now in our 40th season, Dutch Apple combines professional productions with all-inclusive dining for a live dinner theatre experience. We offer big-city entertainment paired with small-town hospitality at an unbeatable value.
